sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in the proximal ends of the first and second
metacarpal bones of left hand (second day),'. — Pain in left arm just below
the elbow, palmar aspect (after one hour),'. — After kneeling or resting on
lower limbs they become numb, with tingling or pricking (eighth day),'. —
Arranged one of the drawers of my desk ; after kneeling, lower limbs
asleep, immovable (this is a two days’ old symptom), (eighth day)/. — Pain
in muscles on the inner side of left leg (second day),'. — Pain in head of
left fibula (second day),'. — Pain in right little toe (second day),'.

Generalities^ Skin, Sleep, and Fever. — [70.] Feeling of
prostration,’. — Bad feeling, involving the nervous system (fifth day),'. —
Nervous at night (seventh day),'. — Have had for a few days an eruption
of pimples on the neck just back of the left ear, covering the mastoid pro¬
cess and bleeding easily (eighth day),'. — At night dream of women (sec¬
ond day),'. — Feeling of coldness,’. — Very cold and chilly, (the day is cold
and weather changing), (eighth day)/. — Cold feeling, with ache at the neck
just below the ear, in the sterno-mastoid muscles, near their insertion
(eighth day),', — Cold feet, feel chilly in a cold room (eighth day),'. — Cold
feet ; coldness of the body (ninth day),'. — [80.] Cold feet (eighth day)/.

Conditions. — Aggravation. — {Morning), Praying mood ; urging to

{Afternoon), Petulant mood ; sore throat; 12.25, pain in muscles of
leftside of neck ; pain in muscles of right side. — {Toward evening), Va.'n\
through globe of eye. — {Evening), Fit of swearing. — {Night), Vindictive
mood. — {Heaving respiration). Oppression at chest. — {After kneeling on
lower extremities), Numbness. — {When writing). Confusion of mind.
